rows.note: This is the all-purpose verb for making something clear or giving its reason.

example.english: I want to explain why I was late.
example.traditional: 我想解釋下點解我遲到。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 gaai2 sik1 haa5 dim2 gaai2 ngo5 ci4 dou3

rows.note: Use this when stressing that the matter is made fully clear or understandable.

example.english: Can you explain clearly how to do the homework?
example.traditional: 你可唔可以講清楚份功課點做呀？
example.jyutping: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 gong2 cing1 co2 fan6 gung1 fo3 dim2 zou6 aa3

rows.note: Use this when someone must account for or justify a reason, action, or situation.

example.english: You need to explain to the boss why you were late.
example.traditional: 你要同老闆交代點解遲到。
example.jyutping: nei5 jiu3 tung4 lou5 baan2 gaau1 doi6 dim2 gaai2 ci4 dou3
